Class ServerBodyAnnotationBinder<T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.core.bind.annotation.AbstractArgumentBinder<T>
io.micronaut.http.bind.binders.DefaultBodyAnnotationBinder<T>
io.micronaut.http.server.binding.ServerBodyAnnotationBinder<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The bound type
All Implemented Interfaces:
AnnotatedArgumentBinder<Body, T, HttpRequest<?>>, ArgumentBinder<T, HttpRequest<?>>, AnnotatedRequestArgumentBinder<Body,T>, BodyArgumentBinder<T>, RequestArgumentBinder<T>
@Internal @Singleton public class ServerBodyAnnotationBinder<T> extends DefaultBodyAnnotationBinder<T>
Server body binding independent of the transport, with hooks for native conversion and legacy state.

    • bodyOf

      public @Nullable ServerHttpRequest<?> bodyOf(HttpRequest<?> source)
      The server request whose bytes are the body of the request a route is bound with: the server request that a request a filter continued with is or wraps, see ServerRequestBody, e.g. the mutable copy of the Netty request, unless the filter set the body to an object, which the default binder converts, like before, or to null, which is no body.
      Parameters:
      source - The request
      Returns:
      The server request, or null if the body is not read from bytes
